mnf_road_short_week_on_production.classification_evidence: Opener primary (week-blocked): 0.000 accuracy points, P+=0.349, interval crosses zero. Neither terminal ground applies: wrong_sign_resolved requires the whole interval on the wrong side (it does not -- the interval is nearly symmetric around zero), and no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible by construction -- mnf_road_short_week_flag is a deterministic function of the published schedule (weekday, home/away designation, calendar gap), with zero measurement noise to split in half (docs/schedule_flag_battery.md section 2). The +44.298-point positive control demonstrates the harness can detect an effect of that size but does not bound THIS effect to a known small ceiling. Therefore unresolved_below_power.
